import-attachment-auth-hint: Ka whakaingoatia e te kaweatu ōna āpitihanga, engari kāore e kawea ngā kōnae. Kia kawea mai, homai te wāhitau o te ratonga me tētahi takiuru: ka whakamahia mō tēnei kawemai anake, ka tukuna ki taua wāhitau anake, ā, kāore rawa e penapenahia. Waiho kia piako hei kawemai me te kore kōnae.
import-attachment-auth-token: Tohu API, kī API, kupuhipa taupānga rānei
import-board-instruction-asana: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kaweake tūmahi Asana ({ "data": [...] } mai i te kaweake Asana, GET /tasks rānei). Ka whakarōpūhia ngā tūmahi ki ngā wāhanga (memberships); ka haere ngā tūmahi kua oti ki Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: I Businessmap (ko Kanbanize i mua), huakina Advanced Search, kōwhiria Configure results hei kōwhiri i ngā tīwae, tikiake i te kōnae Excel, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .xlsx. Ka pānuitia ngā tīwae mā ō rātou ingoa Ingarihi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): mēnā he reo kē tō pūkete, whakaingoatia anōtia te rārangi upoko ki te reo Ingarihi i te tuatahi. Ka huri a Column hei rārangi, a Lane hei ara; ka noho ngā kaipupuri, tūtohu, tae, rā, kōrero me ngā hononga matua ki ō rātou wāhi, ā, ka huri a Priority, Size, Type me ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-clickup: I ClickUp, kaweatu i ngā tūmahi hei CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, te kaweatu rānei o tētahi tirohanga List, Table rānei me ngā tīwae katoa), kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ka huri ngā rārangi ClickUp hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri me ō rātou tūmahi-iti, kaiwhiwhi mahi, tūtohu, rā, matatau me te wā.
import-board-instruction-csv: Whakapiri i ō Uara Wehe Piko (CSV)/Uara Wehe Ripa (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON papa NextCloud Deck (he papa whai "stacks", ā, kei ia stack āna "cards"). Ka noho ngā stacks hei rārangi, ā, ngā cards hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-excel: Kōwhiria he ripanga .xlsx ā-kāhua WeKan (ngā tīwae ōrite ki te kaweake Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Ko te haupae tuatahi te pane.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Wewetehia te kōnae .boardarchive, ā, whakapirihia ngā ihirangi o te board.jsonl o te papa, me te rārangi putanga, me te kore rānei. Ka huri te āhuatanga whakarōpū o te tirohanga papa hei rārangi, ngā āhuatanga kōwhiri kē hei tapanga, ngā poraka kuputuhi me ngā pouakataki hei whakaahuatanga me te rārangi arowhai, ā, ka puritia ngā kōrero. Kāore ngā atahanga me ngā āpitihanga e kawemai.
import-board-instruction-issues: Whakapiri i tētahi huānga JSON take __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ka noho ngā take hei kāri kua whakarōpūhia ki ngā rārangi Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kaweake Kanboard: he ahanoa whai "columns" (he tūmahi rānei whai column_name) me tētahi huānga "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Ka noho ngā tīwae hei rārangi, ā, ngā tūmahi hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-kanri: I Kanri, huakina Import & Export, kōwhiria Export individual board (Export all data rānei), kātahi ka whakapiri i te kōnae .json. Ka huri ngā tīwae hei rārangi, ā, ka noho ngā kāri hei kāri, me ō rātou whakaahuatanga, rā tika, tūtohu me ngā tae; ka huri ngā tūmahi o tētahi kāri hei rārangi arowhai. Mai i tētahi kaweatu raraunga katoa ka kawemai te papa tuatahi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Whakapiria he hanganga Leo (he kōnae .leo). Ka huri ngā wāhanga o te taumata runga rawa hei rārangi, ā, ko ngā wāhanga kei raro tonu i aua wāhanga ka huri hei kāri, me te tuhinga o te wāhanga hei whakaahuatanga. Ka huri ngā wāhanga o ngā taumata hōhonu ake hei rārangi arowhai. Ka kawemai ngā wāhanga kua tohua hei mea kua oti.
import-board-instruction-linear: I Linear, kaweatu i ngā take hei CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, te kaweatu rānei o tētahi tirohanga), kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ka huri ngā tīma hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā take hei kāri me ō rātou kaiwhiwhi mahi, tapanga, rā, take matua, matatau, whakatau tata, kaupapa me te huringa.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Whakapiritia he rārangi mahi markdown (te tikanga e whakamahia ana e ngā taputapu markdown-kanban pēnei i te Obsidian Kanban): ngā pane "## Ingoa rārangi", me ngā tūemi "- [ ]"/"- [x]" kei raro. Ka huri ngā pane hei rārangi, ka huri ngā tūemi hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: I MeisterTask, pāwhiri i te ingoa kaupapa, kōwhiria Export project, kaweatu i te CSV, kātahi ka whakapiri. Ka huri ngā wāhanga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ā rātou tuhipoka, rā tika, kaiwhiwhi mahi me ngā tūtohu; ka pupuri ngā tūmahi kua oti i tō rātou rā i oti ai. Ka mahi hoki tētahi CSV i tuhia mō te kawemai ake a MeisterTask.
import-board-instruction-monday: I monday.com, huakina te tahua papa, kōwhiria More actions me Export board to Excel (me ngā whakahou me ngā tūemi-iti mēnā ka pai koe), kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .xlsx. Ka huri te tīwae Status hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā rōpū hei ara; ka noho ngā tāngata, rā, rārangi wā me ngā tūtohu ki ō rātou wāhi, ka huri ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga, ā, ka huri ngā whakahou hei kōrero.
import-board-instruction-notion: I Notion, huakina te pātengi raraunga hei whārangi katoa, kōwhiria ••• me Export, kōwhiria Markdown & CSV, ka kōwhiri i te kōnae .zip ka tikiakehia, i tētahi CSV pātengi raraunga rānei o roto, whakapiri rānei i taua CSV. Ko tētahi tīwae ko Status te ingoa ka huri hei rārangi (ki te kore, ko te tīwae tuatahi e rite ana ki te select, ā, ka kī te pūrongo kawemai ko tēhea); ka huri ngā rārangi hei kāri me ō rātou taitara, tūtohu hei tapanga, tāngata hei mema, rā, me te kuputuhi whārangi hei whakaahuatanga; ka huri ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga. Kāore e kawemaitia ngā hononga, ngā whakaahua me ngā āpitihanga.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: I Nullboard, huakina te papa, kōwhiria Export this board... i te tahua, huakina te kōnae .nbx ki tētahi ētita kuputuhi, ka whakapiri i ōna ihirangi. Ka huri ngā rārangi hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tuhipoka hei kāri: ko te rārangi tuatahi o tētahi tuhipoka te taitara kāri, ko te toenga tōna whakaahuatanga. Ka whiwhi tētahi tuhipoka raw i te tapanga raw. Ka kawemai tētahi kōnae he maha ōna papa i tōna papa tuatahi.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: I Obsidian, huakina te kōnae o te papa Kanban hei Markdown (huakina rānei te kōnae .md ki tētahi ētita kuputuhi), kātahi ka whakapiri katoa. Ka huri ngā ara hei rārangi me ō rātou tepe kāri, ka pupuri ngā kāri i ā rātou tūtohu, rā, matatau, āpure me te rārangi arowhai, ā, ka huri te Archive hei kāri kua pūrangatia.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kohinga mōkī-mahi OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Ka noho ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ā, ngā mōkī mahi hei kāri.
import-board-instruction-opml: Whakapiri i tētahi whakahuahua OPML, pērā i tā Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq me ētahi atu kaiwhakahuahua e kaweatu ai. Ka huri ngā tūemi taumata-runga hei rārangi, ka huri ā rātou tamariki hei kāri me te tuhipoka hei whakaahuatanga, ā, ka huri ngā tūemi hōhonu ake hei rārangi arowhai. Ka kawemai ngā tūemi kua oti hei mea kua oti.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Whakapiri i tētahi kōnae Org mode, pērā i tā Emacs, Orgzly, Beorg rānei e tuhi ai. Ka huri ngā upoko taumata-runga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā upoko taumata tuarua hei kāri. Ka puritia a TODO me DONE, ngā matatau, ngā tūtohu, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE me CLOSED, ā, ka huri ngā pouaka tohu me ngā upoko hōhonu ake hei rārangi arowhai.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: I Pivotal Tracker, huakina te ripa MORE o te kaupapa, kōwhiria Export CSV (kōwhiria rānei ngā kōrero, ka kōwhiri Bulk Actions, CSV), kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ia tūnga kōrero hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā kōrero hei kāri, me ō rātou momo me ngā tapanga, kaipupuri, kaitono, rā, kōrero, tūmahi me ngā ārai; ka huri a Estimate hei Story points, ā, ka huri ngā huringa hei sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: I Plane, huakina Workspace Settings, kōwhiria Exports, kaweatu i ngā kaupapa hei JSON, CSV, Excel rānei, ka tikiake i te kōnae .zip, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae, i tētahi kōnae rānei o roto, whakapiri rānei i te JSON, CSV rānei. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ka huri ngā kaupapa hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā take hei kāri me ō rātou tautuhi, matua, kaiwhiwhi mahi, tapanga, rā, hononga me ngā kōrero; ka huri te matatau, te whakatau tata, te huringa me te kōwae hei āpure ritenga. Kāore he whakaahuatanga, āpitihanga rānei i te kaweatu a Plane, nō reira kāore e kawemaitia.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: I Quire, huakina te tahua kaupapa, kōwhiria Export CSV, kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka huri ngā tūnga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ō rātou tūmahi-iti hei kāri tamaiti, kaiwhiwhi mahi, tūtohu hei tapanga, rā tīmata, rā tika, rā oti, whakaahuatanga me te matatau hei āpure ritenga. Kāore ngā kōrero me ngā āpitihanga i roto i te CSV a Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: I Redmine, huakina ngā Issues o te kaupapa, kōwhiria Also available in: CSV i raro o te rārangi, kōwhiria ngā tīwae (All columns, me Description), ka kaweatu, kātahi ka whakapiri i te CSV. Ka tapaina e Redmine ngā tīwae ki tō reo, nō reira whakaritea tō reo ki te Ingarihi i My account i mua i te kaweatu. Ka huri ia tūnga hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā take hei kāri, me te tracker hei tapanga, kaiwhiwhi mahi, kaituhi, rā, tūmahi matua me ngā take hāngai; ka huri te matatau, te kāwai, te putanga whāinga, te wā i whakatau tatahia, % Done me ngā āpure ritenga hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: I Super Productivity, huakina Settings, kātahi Sync & Backup, kōwhiria Export Data, ka whakapiri i ngā ihirangi o te kōnae sp-backup .json. Ka huri ia kaupapa hei ara, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri i To Do, In Progress, Backlog, Done rānei, me ā rātou tuhipoka, tūtohu, rā tika, wā i pau me ngā tūmahi-iti; ka huri ngā tūmahi kua pūrangatia hei kāri kua pūrangatia.
import-board-instruction-taiga: I Taiga, huakina Admin > Project > Export, ka tikiake i te putunga kaupapa (wetekina tētahi kōnae .json.gz i te tuatahi), kātahi ka whakapiri i tōna JSON. Ka huri ngā tūnga user story hei rārangi, ka huri ngā user story hei kāri me ā rātou tūmahi hei tūmahi-iti, ka whiwhi ngā epic me ngā take i ō rātou ake ara, ā, ka haere tahi mai ngā sprint, tūtohu, kōrero me ngā āhuatanga ritenga. Kāore e kawemaitia ngā āpitihanga.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: I Tasks.org, huakina Settings, Backups, kōwhiria Export tasks, kātahi ka whakapiri i ngā ihirangi o taua kōnae .json. Ka huri ngā rārangi hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ā rātou tuhipoka, tūtohu, rā, kōrero me ngā tūmahi-iti; ka pupuri ngā tūmahi kua oti i tō rātou rā i oti ai, ā, ka huri te matatau hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Whakapirihia te putanga o task export: he mahere huānga JSON, he tūmahi kotahi rānei ki ia rārangi. Ka haere ngā tūmahi kua oti ki Done, ka huri a project me priority hei tapanga, a annotations hei kōrero, ā, a depends hei hononga whakawhirinaki ki ngā tūmahi e ārai ana.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: I Teamwork.com, whakakīia te tauira kawemai tūmahi Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status), tiakina hei .xlsx, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae. Ka huri ngā rārangi tūmahi hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri; ko tētahi tūmahi ka tīmata ki te -, # rānei, > rānei ka huri hei tūmahi-iti o te tūmahi kei runga ake (--, ## rānei, >> rānei kotahi te taumata hōhonu ake). Ka noho ngā kaiwhiwhi mahi, rā me ngā tūtohu ki ō rātou wāhi; ka huri a Priority, Estimated time me Complete hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: I TickTick, huakina Settings, Account, Backup & Import, ka hanga i tētahi tārua, kātahi ka whakapiri i te kōnae CSV. Ka huri ia rārangi TickTick hei ara, ā, ka huri ōna tīwae hei rārangi; ka pupuri ngā tūmahi i ā rātou tūtohu, rā, rārangi arowhai, matatau me ngā tūmahi-iti.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Whakapirihia he kōnae todo.txt: kotahi te mahi ki ia rārangi, pēnei i te tuhi a te taupānga todo.txt me ngā taupānga hototahi. Ka haere ngā mahi kua oti ("x") ki te wāhanga Kua oti, ka huri a +project me @context hei tapanga, ka huri a (A) hei tapanga whakaarotau, ā, ka huri a due: me t: hei rā kati, hei rā tīmata hoki.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: I Vikunja, huakina Settings, kōwhiria Data Export, ka tikiake i te kōnae .zip ka tukuna mai ki a koe, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae, whakapiri rānei i te data.json kei roto. Ka huri ngā peere Kanban hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ō rātou tapanga, kaiwhiwhi mahi, rā, whakaahuatanga, rārangi tūmahi hei rārangi arowhai me ngā kōrero; ka huri te matatau, te ōrau kua oti me te kua oti hei āpure ritenga. Kāore e kawemaitia ngā āpitihanga.
import-board-instruction-wrike: I Wrike, kaweatu i tētahi kaupapa, kōpaki rānei ki Excel, whakakīia rānei te tauira kawemai Excel a Wrike, kātahi ka kōwhiri i taua kōnae .xlsx. Ka huri ngā rārangi kōpaki me ngā kaupapa hei ara, ka huri a Status hei rārangi, ā, ka huri ngā tūmahi hei kāri, me ō rātou Key, tūmahi matua, kaiwhiwhi mahi, rā tīmata me te rā mutunga, ngā whakawhirinakitanga me te whakaahuatanga; ka huri a Priority, Duration me ētahi atu tīwae hei āpure ritenga.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Whakapiri i tētahi JSON kaweake rārangi ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Ka noho ngā stages hei rārangi, ā, ngā items hei kāri.

import-members-mode-placeholder: Puritia hei kaiwhakamahi pupuri wāhi me ō rātou ake ingoa, hei mahere ki ngā kaiwhakamahi tūturu ā muri ake
import-not-wekan-export: Ehara taua kōnae i te kaweake WeKan
import-one-board-per-project: Kotahi te papa mō ia kaupapa
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Ka huri ia ara ka hangaia e te kawemai (he kaupapa, he kōpaki, he rārangi rānei o te taputapu) hei papa motuhake. Ka whakarārangitia ngā kāri matua me ngā whakawhirinakitanga i waenga i aua papa i te pūrongo kawemai.
import-report-description: Kua waihangatia te papa, engari kāore i taea te kawe mai i ētahi wāhanga o te kōnae. Ka puritia taua pūrongo ki Papatohu Kaiwhakahaere → Ngā Raruraru → Whakaora.

import-without-mapping-members: Kawemai me te kore e mahere mema (mahere ā muri ake)
instance-desc: Ka taea e ia kaiwhakamahi kua takiuru ki tēnei WeKan te tiro i tēnei papa. Kāore rawa e whakaaturia ki ngā tāngata kāore anō kia takiuru. Ko ngā tāngata kua tāpirihia ki te papa anake ka āhei ki te whakatika.
invalid-file: Ki te muhu te ingoa kōnae, ka whakakorea te tukuatu, te whakaingoa anō rānei.

list-permissions-desc: Ngā mahi ka āhei i ia tūnga i tēnei rārangi, i tua atu i tā te papa e whakaae ai. Ka taea tonu e ngā kaiwhakahaere papa te whakatika.

muted-info: E kore rawa koe e whakamōhiotia mō ngā huringa o tēnei papa
